items.question: What is the waiting period for kidney stones?
evidence: covered only after 24 months of continuous cover
items.reference: Kidney stones are covered after 24 months of continuous cover (Section 10.1).

items.question: How many days before admission are medical bills paid?
evidence: incurred in the 30 days before admission
items.reference: Expenses in the 30 days before admission (Section 3.2).

items.question: What is the Wellness Bonus?
evidence: increases the sum insured by 10 for each claim free year
items.reference: 10% more Sum Insured per claim-free year, up to 50% (Section 4.1).

items.question: What is the annual premium for age 40 with a Sum Insured of 10 lakh?
Does the policy cover pet insurance for dogs?
items.reference: Not specified in the provided policy text.

items.question: Is joint replacement after an accident subject to the waiting period?
evidence: joint replacement unless caused by an accident
items.reference: No: the 24-month waiting period does not apply when the joint replacement is caused by an accident.
